gap_reasons: The flagship generic selector-range conjecture is not proved; the note proves only a one-dimensional nonradial repair and refutes the unqualified one-dimensional claim.
The original unqualified one-dimensional conjecture is refuted, and the repair is a nonradial one-dimensional condition rather than a broad generic-class result.
Assessed derivation tier is at most subfield, below novelty_target=flagship; accepting at a downgraded tier is forbidden by the prompt.

Proposition 4 claims the witness satisfies the generic-stratum condition from Conjecture 2. That is not established and appears false: in the A=0 arm the two bridge rows are identical ... so the rank drop that creates the one-dimensional fiber is destroyed by arbitrarily small perturbations of the observable law.

The main mathematics actually delivered is finite convex geometry of the bridge fiber, a null-annihilator criterion, ... a one-dimensional nonradial selector formula, and one explicit binary table. These are coherent diagnostics, but they are not a flagship regime-opening theorem.

The statement invokes a common 'efficiency-bound object' for the profiled minimax selected ATE, but §6/§7 define only finite first-order influence functions, not the semiparametric model, tangent space, or variance functional that makes an efficiency bound well-defined.
proof_attempt_summary: Attempted a flagship sharp proximal-completeness phase transition for the ATE: a closed-form critical singular value sigma_star giving strict point / interval / Manski phase boundaries when proxy completeness fails. The original angle reached a flagship ACCEPT at proposal (angle 1 v3), but the D0.5 derivation collapsed: the generic open-class selector-range Conjecture 1 was never proved, the unqualified one-dimensional claim was refuted by a radial counterexample, and the binary witness (Prop. 4) fails its own generic-stratum condition (A=0 duplicate proxy rows make the rank drop unstable under arbitrarily small perturbations). The pivot to a fresh angle 2 cycled six revisions, only twice touching flagship (last blocked on an undefined efficiency-bound object) before the revision cap exhausted to a NO-PASS@flagship. Remains: sound field-tier finite convex geometry (null-annihilator criterion, exact-fiber Tikhonov limit, nonradial 1-D selector formula) — but no flagship regime-opening theorem.
